pause_selection: Same earliest qualified pause per animal and first eight source-identified units as v1 and v2; no substitutions
generator: Unchanged conditional independent Poisson generator, native theta, phase preference shifts, per-pause seeds, support and clock gaps. No interactions or replay-driven changes. This bank is development, not independent validation.
comparison: Bounded-speed v3 GLM versus exact-intensity oracle on identical counts and physical support. Missing/nonconverged predictions stop the run; independent numerical verification tolerances are not relaxed.
predictive_quality: Across each of the fixed eight animal/period groups, require the Bonferroni-corrected 95% Monte Carlo interval for mean heldout Poisson improvement over a training-only global-rate comparator to be wholly positive. Any unsupported period is rate_prediction_failed, even if no pair-bias interval excludes zero. Report estimator spread as well as mean bias; absence of detectable bias is not equivalence or adequate power.
summary: Same fixed 112 pair-discrepancy family, 200 draws and simultaneous Monte Carlo intervals as v1. Pairs are dependent, not biological subjects.
claim_boundary: Development only. Require separate six-generator full-procedure validation, validated replay, preceding-coordination adjustment and animal-level shuffle inference before association interpretation. PF native theta remains missing.
